functions.name: CResourceCompilerTexture_CompileResourceInternal
functions.note: per output channel group: inputs, GenerateMips (180142990) per frame, the first group sets the output size and level count (leaves its level loop at a group mip count of 1), a larger later group upsizes the output (18013ce60); averages each group's last mip (180c3bb80) and adds avg[src] to the destination's reflectivity while copying level 0 (181277690); DXT5 -> DXT1 when plane 3 of every kept mip is 1 (ledgers 230, 240)

functions.name: CTextureFrame_GenerateMips
functions.note: dispatch by name: ArtistDefined(/OrAlphaWeighted) via the image's artist string (empty -> Box / AlphaWeighted), None 180144200, Box / Box<n> 1801443f0, BoxInverse 1801447c0, MultiplyBox / MultiplyNoMip 180144ce0, MipNormal (dep Mip Normals, then Box), HemiOctNormal 18014c050, HemiOctIsoRoughness_RG_B / AnisoRoughness_RG (180148350 then a shuffle), HemiOctAnisoRoughness (180148350 raw), AnisoNormal 18014c660, AlphaWeighted 18014e680, PreserveCoverage 18014fa90, GGXCubeMapBlur 180150130, RGBM 180151310, Nice 180151cf0 (ledger 231)

functions.name: CTextureFrame_GenerateMips_None
functions.note: dep Mip None 1; level 0 copied (180c3c3c0) as the only level (ledger 231)

functions.name: CTextureFrame_GenerateMips_Box
functions.note: dep Mip Box 1; levels min(mip count 180c49440, param_7), each QuarterSize (180c43450) of the one before; non-power-of-two only with AllowNP2Textures

functions.name: CTextureFrame_GenerateMips_BoxInverse
functions.note: dep Mip Box Inverse 1; power of two only; level 0 = v * -1 + 1 per masked channel (+0x8a0), then QuarterSize per level (ledger 231)

functions.name: CTextureFrame_GenerateMips_PreserveCoverage
functions.note: dep Mip PreserveCoverage 5; power of two only; target = coverage(input, 1); per level QuarterSize to a scratch, copy, unless target <= 0 or 1x1: bisection on [0, 8] to 0.01 (mid (hi + lo) * 0.5), scale planes 0..2, clamp [0, 1] (180142710), restore uniform pixels (18014f840) (ledger 231)

functions.name: TextureFrame_AlphaTestCoverage
functions.note: plane 0 scaled and clamped (maxss 0, minss 1) at each 2x2 cell's corners, 16 samples from the weight table (stack, from 0x182a9ecd0 .. 0x182a9ee10), counted at v >= 0.5; count / (float)(((h-1)(w-1)) << 4)

functions.name: TextureFrame_ClampPlane
functions.note: maxps(v, lo) then minps(v, hi) over one plane

functions.name: PreserveCoverage_KeepUniform
functions.note: in place, row by row: a pixel whose clamped 3x3 neighbourhood of plane 0 is all >= 0.5 or all < 0.5 takes planes 0..2 of the unscaled level back

functions.name: ImageFormat_MipCount
functions.note: levels to 1x1, each side halved and floored at 1

functions.name: HemiOctAnisoRoughness_Lambda
functions.note: x = 2 m10 - 1, y = 2 m11 - 1, z = sqrt(clamp(1 - (y y + x x))), inv = 1 / ((|y| + |x|) + z); plane 3 (x' + y') / 2 + 1/2, plane 1 (x' - y') / 2 + 1/2, plane 0 ch6 + ch4, plane 2 ch7 + ch5 (MinRoughness clamps unset) (ledger 231)

functions.name: CTextureFrame_ApplyImageProcessor
functions.note: by name (V_stricmp_fast): Mod2XCenter 18013fee0, NormalizeNormals 180140120, FillToPowerOfTwo 180140550, FillToMultipleOfFour 180140ae0, ScaleToPowerOfTwo (inline), HeightToNormal 180141080, Inverse 180141590, ConvertToYCoCg 180141720, DilateColorInTransparentPixels 180141be0, EncodeRGBM 180142040, UniformRandom<w>x<h>x<d> 180140320 (ledger 232)

functions.name: CTextureFrame_ImageProcessor_Mod2X
functions.note: dep Image Mod2X 1; per masked channel the row-order sum, then each pixel (0.5 - sum / (w h)) + v (ledger 232)

functions.name: Red2_FinalizeAndSort
functions.note: MSVC std::sort of each RED2 list (18017a780, 18017a9c0, 18017abe0, 18017ae90, 18017b0a0, 18017a5a0) and of the three searchable tables' members (181ebae60), then Red2_WriteBlock 181c24a70; every comparator V_stricmp_fast (ledger 235)

functions.name: KV3_SortTableMembers
functions.note: a table (type 9) only: 181ea5d30 sorts its member index by std::sort 181ea6ae0 with V_stricmp_fast on the names (ledger 235)

functions.name: CResourceCompilerVectorGraphic_Compile
functions.note: dep Vector Graphic Version 2; the source file's bytes into a CUtlBuffer, then the Panorama writer 1800f6960 (ledger 236)

functions.name: HelperLoadFbmByFileExtension
functions.note: by extension: exr, psd, tga (180c70980 then RGBA8888 into the bitmap), tif, png, jpg, webp

functions.name: TGA_Decode
functions.note: types 1/3 (palette or grey), 2 (24 bits 180c70c20, 32 bits 180c70da0), 9 (palette refused), 10, 11; rows bottom-up unless descriptor & 0x20; no other descriptor bit read (ledger 238)

functions.name: TGA_Row32
functions.note: BGRA to RGBA per pixel, the fourth byte as alpha as it is (ledger 238)

functions.name: Material_RepresentativeTextureSize
functions.note: over the attributes: at the one named RepresentativeTexture, its bound texture's size as RepresentativeTextureWidth / Height int attributes (ledger 239)
